name: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana
summary: A financial inclusion mission that provides every household with a basic zero-balance savings bank account, a RuPay debit card, an overdraft facility and accident insurance cover.

eligibility_clauses.text: The applicant must be 10 years of age or older.

entitlement_rules.text: Account holders receive an accident insurance cover of Rs. 2 lakh on the RuPay debit card.

appeal_hierarchy.description: First grievance at the bank branch.
Final grievance before the Banking Ombudsman.
